{{Top|leg}}
A '''dart rifle''' was a projectile weapon that fired [[Dart/Legends|darts]] from long ranges.<ref name="MK">''[[X-Wing: Mercy Kill]]''</ref>

In [[44 ABY]],<ref name="TERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of ''[[X-Wing: Mercy Kill]]'' to [[44 ABY]].</ref> [[Drikall Bessarah]], a member of the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]] [[Commando/Legends|commando]] unit [[Wraith Squadron]], fired a dart from his rifle that struck a fleeing [[General/Legends|General]] [[Stavin Thaal]] in the neck, paralyzing him.<ref name="MK" />
